title: Design System: Warren Hall Seller Authority

label.purpose: Navigation, actions, authorship, and media state.

shadows.name: interactive-low
shadows.purpose: Compact lift for interactive hover states only.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: State changes and the single composed first-load reveal.

components.name: Private Valuation Button
components.description: The primary action for qualified seller conversations.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--color-primary); color: var(--color-ink); padding: 0.875rem 1.25rem; border: 0; border-radius: var(--radius-sm); font: 700 0.875rem/1.3 Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; transition: background 180ms var(--ease-out), transform 180ms var(--ease-out); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--color-primary-deep); color: var(--color-bg); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--color-primary); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Private Consultation Button
components.description: The secondary action for buyers, relocation clients, and private conversations.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: var(--color-ink); color: var(--color-bg); padding: 0.875rem 1.25rem; border: 0; border-radius: var(--radius-sm); font: 700 0.875rem/1.3 Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; transition: background 180ms var(--ease-out); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--color-muted); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--color-primary); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Contact Field
components.description: A clear, private-review-safe text field pattern for later approved forms.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 0.5rem; color: var(--color-ink); font: 700 0.875rem/1.3 Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; } .ds-field input { min-height: 3rem; padding: 0.75rem 0.875rem; border: 1px solid var(--color-line); border-radius: var(--radius-sm); background: var(--color-bg); color: var(--color-ink); font: 400 1rem/1.5 Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { border-color: var(--color-ink); outline: 3px solid var(--color-primary); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Primary Navigation
components.description: Concise crawlable links with a visible active treatment.
components.html: HomeSellMarket Mindset
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 1.25rem; font: 700 0.875rem/1.3 Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; } .ds-nav a { color: var(--color-ink); text-decoration-color: transparent; text-underline-offset: 0.3em; transition: text-decoration-color 180ms var(--ease-out); } .ds-nav a:hover, .ds-nav a[aria-current="page"] { text-decoration-color: var(--color-primary-deep); } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--color-primary); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Market Mindset Item
components.description: A question-led knowledge item with evidence and a canonical destination.
components.html:
What should I do before listing my Raleigh home?

Warren explains the decisions that shape timing, presentation, and negotiation.

Read Warren's answer
components.css: .ds-mindset { max-width: 36rem; padding: 1.5rem; background: var(--color-surface); border-radius: var(--radius-md); color: var(--color-ink); } .ds-mindset h3 { margin: 0 0 0.75rem; font: 400 1.75rem/1.15 Georgia, Times, serif; letter-spacing: -0.03em; } .ds-mindset p { margin: 0 0 1rem; color: var(--color-muted); font: 400 1rem/1.6 Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; } .ds-mindset a { color: var(--color-ink); font: 700 0.875rem/1.3 Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; text-underline-offset: 0.3em; } .ds-mindset a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--color-primary); outline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.overview:
The system should feel like a prepared advisor setting a concise, evidence-backed briefing in front of an established Triangle homeowner. True white reading space, ink-blue structure, a controlled honey-gold accent, and Warren's approved portrait create calm authority without borrowing the costumes of generic luxury marketing.

The composition is image-led and assured, with asymmetric pacing and generous breathing room. It rejects beige editorial clichés, brokerage-template sameness, influencer performance, and card-heavy AI scaffolding. Content remains useful and visible without motion; enhancements are quiet, purposeful, and fully reduced-motion safe.
keyCharacteristics: Raleigh-native confidence expressed through specificity, not superlatives.
A committed dark-and-white structure with honey-gold reserved for decisive actions.
Warren and verified evidence lead; property inventory does not.
Page spacing uses the shared fluid page token and responsive layouts avoid clipped headlines.

rules.name: The Honey-Gold Rule
rules.body: Gold identifies meaningful decisions and scarce emphasis; it never washes entire reading surfaces.

rules.name: The Brokerage Identity Rule
rules.body: Compass red appears only when official identity requires it and never becomes the Warren Hall theme.

rules.name: The Speaking Distance Rule
rules.body: Display tracking never tightens beyond -0.03em, and body copy never extends beyond 72ch.

rules.name: The Evidence Has Weight Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy comes from content, contrast, scale, and spacing; decorative ghost cards are forbidden.

dos: Do lead with Warren's approved portrait and verified judgment before property inventory.
Do use true white, ink-blue structure, and the canonical honey-gold roles exactly as defined in the frontmatter.
Do keep every action keyboard accessible, every focus state visible, and every motion effect reduced-motion safe.
Do use asymmetric pacing and concrete Raleigh/Triangle evidence to make the experience feel like a private briefing.
Do reserve repeated containers for genuinely browsable Market Mindset collections.
donts: Don't copy List It With Liza, Compass corporate pages, or generic Luxury Presence templates.
Don't use flashy mansion montages, playful influencer styling, hollow luxury language, or unsupported superlatives.
Don't use beige editorial clichés, repetitive card grids, or cold brokerage-template copy.
Don't use the editorial-magazine aesthetic lane of italic display serif, tiny mono labels, ruled columns, and monochromatic affectation.
Don't use gradient text, decorative glassmorphism, colored side-stripe borders, diagonal stripe backgrounds, decorative grids, or sketchy SVG scenes.
Don't exceed 0.75rem corner radii on cards and sections, pair a one-pixel border with a shadow blur of 16px or more, or clip long headings on small screens.
